title: Analysis of titanium-nanotube sphere, later stolen

tellings.quote: And um like that sphere was um a made of a titanium alloy that um had carbon nano tubes also built into the metal which I think provided thrust by the the Bfield Brown effect.

plain: A sphere recovered in Mexico and studied in the United States was made of a titanium alloy with carbon nanotubes, tiny tubes of carbon, built into the metal, according to Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants and who says he worked on it. Colbern thinks the nanotubes gave it thrust through the Biefeld-Brown effect, a claimed push produced by high voltage across charged surfaces. He says the sphere was later stolen, so it would have been physical evidence of an engineered flying object that is now gone.
